name: Witch Doctor: Beware Da Voodoo and Touch of Mueh'zala lengthen ward/spirit durations natively (#869, #3068)
contract: #869: Beware Da Voodoo 707168 is one effect, aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION, SpellDefines.h:76), EffectBasePoints 3999 + DieSides 1 = +4000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask [512, 8192, 0], SpellFamilyName 19. That mask matches Mimic Ward 707162 (SpellFamilyFlags [8704=0x2200, 0, 0], bit 9 = 512 in word 0) and Spirit 561136 (SpellFamilyFlags [0, 8192, 4], bit 13 = 8192 in word 1) -- the tooltip's 'Mimic Ward and Spirits'. Both have DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms (SpellDuration.dbc). #3068: Touch of Mueh'zala 706538 is the same aura/op pattern, EffectBasePoints 999 + DieSides 1 = +1000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask [0, 16384, 0], matching Stasis 801677 (SpellFamilyFlags [0, 16384, 0], bit 14 in word 1, the Stasis Ward's stun) which has DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms. Stasis is cast by the Stasis Ward creature on itself (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:460: me->CastSpell(me, Stasis, true, nullptr, nullptr, _owner)), whose owner GUID is set to the player (Summons.cpp:170: summon->SetOwnerGUID(player->GetGUID())), so Aura::CalcMaxDuration's caster->GetSpellModOwner() chain (SpellAuras.cpp, via Unit::GetSpellModOwner/GetOwner) resolves to the player and applies the player's own SPELLMOD_DURATION mods -- no module code needed for either talent; both are the generic core SpellMod pattern (parity contract rule 7). Neither talent's class mask overlaps the other's target, and neither touches Spirit Glaive's duration; those are asserted as controls. All numbers (4000, 1000, 12000, 4000 base) are cited from Spell.dbc/SpellDuration.dbc, not invented. Regression guard for native behaviour; both issues classify works_natively.
